description: Give your business an always-available assistant that helps you respond to customers, stay on top of conversations, and handle everyday work faster—while keeping you in control.
Run your shop with less stress. Keep products organized, track stock, receive customer orders, and manage your online storefront from one simple place.
Keep your business images, documents, and other important files together in a dependable home, ready to use across your website and business tools.
Manage user authentication, identity, and secure access for your Internet Computer applications.
Store and retrieve structured key-value data on the Internet Computer.
Use a SQL database canister to manage relational data for your Internet Computer application.
Accept customer payments through Kora checkout and track payment results in your project.
Accept customer payments through Paystack and track payment results in your project.
Manage a restaurant menu, portion-based orders, kitchen fulfillment, and payment collection.
